name: Xal'atath
description: A ranged damage dealer who manipulates void energy to overwhelm enemies and control the battlefield.
title: The Harbinger of the Void
info: For eons, Xal'atath has manipulated gods and mortals alike to ascend the cosmic ladder. Once a servant of Dimensius the All-Devouring, and then a prisoner of the Old Gods, Xal'atath has now attained her freedom and set her own plans in motion—starting with the destruction of Dalaran and the transformation of the Sunwell.

Xalatath.name: Shadow Mark
Xalatath.description: Shoot a Void Orb that deals 75 (+4% per level) damage to enemies hit, and an additional 150 (+4% per level) damage to enemies in the center.  If an enemy Hero or Structure is hit by the center, they are marked for 4 seconds.  Targets afflicted by Shadow Mark are Revealed and draw the Dark Heart and Void Minions towards them.

Xalatath.name: Dark Heart Ritual
Xalatath.description: Summon the Dark Heart, which pulses for 50 (+4% per level) damage per second to nearby enemies and lasts 8 seconds.  The Dark Heart moves to Shadow Mark's impact location.  The Dark Heart will pursue targets afflicted by Shadow Mark and detonate on impact, dealing 305 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies and 152 (+4% per level) more damage to the Marked target.

Xalatath.name: Void Step
Xalatath.description: Cast to teleport Xal'atath 3 times in a triangular pattern.  Each time Xal'atath teleports, her Basic Attacks deal 10% more damage while the Ability is active.  Reactivate to end Void Step early and remain at your current location.  Weapon Bonus Damage caps at +30%.

Xalatath.name: Void Eruption
Xalatath.description: Channel a powerful Void Orb that grows over time until reaching maximum size after 2 seconds. Recast to launch the Orb early.  Enemies that come into contact with the Orb take 112 (+4% per level) damage and are Blinded for 1 second.  When the Orb reaches the end of its path, it detonates in a large explosion, dealing 400 (+4% per level) damage.  Charging up this Ability increases its contact damage up to 175 (+4% per level) and its explosion damage up to 700 (+4% per level).  Contact damage is dealt every 0.25 seconds.

Xalatath.name: Void Convergence
Xalatath.description: After channeling for 2 seconds, summon a Void Portal that spawns up to 3 Void Minions to attack nearby enemies.  You can have up to 1 active Void Portal.  Enemies near the Void Portal are Slowed by 25%.  Void Minions are attracted to targets afflicted by Shadow Mark.  The Portal expires after 12 seconds. Void Minions automatically choose a nearby lane to push. Void Minion Basic Attacks deal 50 (+4% per level) damage per hit. Void Minions lose Health over 12 seconds.

Xalatath.name: Void Volley
Xalatath.description: After attacking enemies with her Basic Attacks 5 times, Xal'atath can activate Void Volley to unleash a barrage of 6 Void Orbs at a target location, each dealing 90 (+4% per level) damage on impact.  Charge fully decays if Xal'atath does not hit an enemy with a Basic Attack after 6 seconds.  Quest: Hit enemy Heroes with Void Volley to grant 1 stack per hit and increases Void Volley's damage by 1%. Lose all stacks upon dying.  Reward (20 Stacks):   +2 Void Volley Range   Stack loss on death lowered to 6.  Reward (60 Stacks):   -1 Basic Attack required to charge Void Volley.  Mythic Reward (100 Stacks):   +50% Basic Attack and Void Volley Damage.   Void Volley projectiles Pierce all targets.  Stack loss will never cause the Hero to fall below a quest reward threshold.

1.name: Void Adept
1.description: Quest: Detonate the Dark Heart on targets afflicted by Shadow Mark.  Each successful detonation permanently increases Shadow Mark and the Dark Heart Ritual Detonation damage by 25, up to 20 times.

1.name: Anchored Core
1.description: Dark Heart Ritual: +50% Radius +25% Duration  Dark Heart's damage bounces 2 times from the primary target to nearby enemies, dealing 25 (+4% per level) damage.

1.name: Cloak of Shadows
1.description: Activating Void Step grants 50% Movement Speed and 25 Spell Armor for 2 seconds. This bonus refreshes each time Xal'atath teleports.

4.name: Cold Feet
4.description: +1s Shadow Mark Duration  Heroes afflicted by Shadow Mark have their Movement Speed reduced by 25%.

4.name: Dark Barrier
4.description: Each time Dark Heart damages an enemy, Xal'atath gains a Shield equal to 2% of her maximum Health, up to 10%.

4.name: Void Acolyte
4.description: Completing Void Step fully charges Void Volley.  The next Void Volley deals 50% increased damage and costs no Mana.

7.name: Toxic Mark
7.description: +1s Shadow Mark Duration  Heroes affliced with Shadow Mark have their Armor reduced by 15 and take damage equal to 1% of their maximum Health every second.

7.name: Silence of the Lamb
7.description: Activating Void Step summons a seal of void magic on the ground. When the seal completes, it deals 250 (+4% per level) damage to enemies inside and Silences them for 2 seconds.

7.name: Void Summoner
7.description: Activating Void Step summons a single Void Minion in Xalataths original postion. Void Minions are attracted to targets afflicted by Shadow Mark.  Void Minions automatically choose a nearby lane to push. Void Minion Basic Attacks deal 50 (+4% per level) damage per hit. Void Minion loses Health over 12 seconds.

13.name: Pull of the Dark Heart
13.description: Enemies damaged by the Dark Heart Ritual are Slowed by 10% for each pulse, stacking up to 5 times and decaying over 2 seconds.

13.name: Dark Heart's Protection
13.description: Casting Dark Heart Ritual Silences enemies inside its radius for 1 second.  Xal'atath and allied Heroes gain 30 Spell Armor while inside the Dark Heart's radius.

13.name: Crushing Cascade
13.description: Enemies hit by Void Volley are Slowed by 6% for 2 seconds per projectile, up to 50%.

16.name: Marked Resilience
16.description: Basic Attacks against targets afflicted by Shadow Mark grant a 0~~NaN~~ point Shield that rapidly decays.  Shield starts decaying after 1 second, decays over 2 seconds.

16.name: Relentless Whispers
16.description: While Void Step is active, Xal'atath's Basic Attack Speed is increased by 150%.

16.name: Fractured Reality
16.description: +25% Void Volley Projectile Damage  Void Volley's projectiles leave behind a trail of fire for 3 seconds, constantly dealing 9 (+4% per level) damage to enemies. Damage is increased the longer a target stands in the flames.  Damage is dealt every 0.1875 seconds. Damage increases up to 300%. Damage increase from multiple fires stack.

20.name: Harbinger's Consumption
20.description: Void Eruption splits into 3 orbiting Void Orbs. Each enemy Hero hit by their explosions reduces Void Eruption's cooldown by 14 seconds.

20.name: Rift Invasion
20.description: Void Convergence's Void Portal no longer has a life duration, raises the active Void Portal limit to 2, and can spawn and sustain up to 4 Void Minions.

20.name: Dueling Orbs
20.description: +1 Shadow Mark Charge  Shadow Mark has a 3 second cooldown between uses.

20.name: Unstable Core
20.description: When the Dark Heart expires or detonates on a target afflicted by Shadow Mark, it leaves behind a pool of void flames for 5 seconds. Enemies in the flames take 45 (+4% per level) damage over time.  The flames deal damage every 1 second.

20.name: Paradox Loop
20.description: After completing Void Step, Xal'atath immediately performs a second Void Step in the opposite direction. Added effects are triggered again.
